evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never framed the call length, dependable quote promise, or waited for a yes before diving into probing. Jumped directly to 'I just have this is a good contact number for you' and then 'do you have any questions or concerns' without the 10-15 minute time-box framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked as 'do you have any questions or concerns about the move that you would like answered on this call today?' but this came AFTER the rep had already confirmed the contact number and email — minimal probing had started, but the customer answered 'No, I don't think so,' so no concern was raised for follow-up.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (first floor origin / second floor destination), rooms (2 bedrooms both locations), walking distance (noted at both ends), special considerations (60-inch TV with box, ~300 books, 2 beds, 2 desks, work equipment with screens, bookshelves, sideboards, dining table with chairs), bookshelf count detail (12 bigger pieces, 1 corner piece, 3 half-size pieces). All seven logistics elements covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'typical box move for this size is usually about 35 to 45 boxes, but if we include those books, it's gonna be a lot more than that.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided time-based estimate: 'system estimated this move for about five and a half hours... typical move without the size usually takes about 6:00 to seven... I think we will fall closer to the seven hours' and then 'I'm gonna increase it to $7 [likely meaning 7 hours].' Personalized to the books consideration and customer's stated intention to move some items herself before move day.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentioned hourly rate with inclusions ('everything's included in the hourly rate taxes, insurance, that fuel and truck all wrap pads') but did NOT mention trip fee, overnight fee, packing materials, the 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, or 'not a guess' commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or any variant. After stating the 7-hour estimate, moved directly to other topics.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep mentioned 'no worries damage coverage or is that free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages' — mentioned the $2,000 and that it's included, but the phrasing is garbled and does NOT clearly state 'no deductible / no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent, and did not explicitly close the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Asked as 'And then do you have any other questions for me?' — this is the empty 'any questions?' throwaway variant, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' framing. Customer answered 'Not that I can sync of right now. No.'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears in the transcript.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any direct ask for the business. Call ended with 'Well if you do have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out to us... Well you have a good rest of your day. Thank you.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking was confirmed. No date re-confirmed, no phone number confirmed as contact, no arrival window set, no crew size discussed, no addresses re-confirmed, no notes left for crew. The call ended without any booking action.

top_strength: Rep gathered thorough logistics details (property types, floor levels, walking distances, special items including the significant book collection and furniture inventory) and provided a time-anchored, personalized estimate that accounted for the customer's uncertain packing needs.
coaching_note: Open with the quid pro quo framing (10–15 minutes, dependable quote, wait for yes), ask 'Their Agenda' before any probing starts, deliver both Two Promises in full with clear no-deductible framing, and always close with the explicit ask ('Would you like our help?') followed by booking confirmation — you skipped all four of these critical closing moves, leaving the deal incomplete.
